sloka: सत्यवादी मधुरवाग् देवो वाचस्पतिर्यथा ।रूपवान् सुभगः श्रीमान् कन्दर्प इव मूर्तिमान् ।। ५.३४.२९।।
transliteration: satyavādī madhuravāg devo vācaspatiryathā ।rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān kandarpa iva mūrtimān ।। 5.34.29।।

translations.english: "Rama is glorious as the Sun, brings delight to the whole world like the Moon, is the king of kings like Vaisravana, and renowned like Visnu endowed with valour.
